mapper.select: SELECT *, ST_AsText(geom) AS geomText FROM xian_gdp_people WHERE POWER( (ST_X(ST_Transform(ST_Centroid(geom), 3857)) - ST_X(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4490), 3857))) * COS(#{rotation} * PI() / 180) + (ST_Y(ST_Transform(ST_Centroid(geom), 3857)) - ST_Y(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4490), 3857))) * SIN(#{rotation} * PI() / 180), 2 ) / POWER(#{semiMajorAxis}, 2) + POWER( - (ST_X(ST_Transform(ST_Centroid(geom), 3857)) - ST_X(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4490), 3857))) * SIN(#{rotation} * PI() / 180) + (ST_Y(ST_Transform(ST_Centroid(geom), 3857)) - ST_Y(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4490), 3857))) * COS(#{rotation} * PI() / 180), 2 ) / POWER(#{semiMinorAxis}, 2) <= 1
